about_the_game:
August, the cicadas chirp loudly, and the summer heat lingers. Yet here you stand again, at the starting point of the senior year of high school—only this time, your identity is a "repeater".

You will play the role of a college entrance examination warrior who, burdened with expectations, pressure, and unwillingness, chooses to return to this purgatory. The familiar classroom is filled with brand-new faces; the same knowledge carries an indescribable weight. The clock seems to have turned back, yet also seems to be ticking away faster.

This year is a lonely journey:

Facing the sense of gap as former classmates have entered universities, you silently chew on that subtle alienation.

Bearing the silent anxiety and hope of your parents, you seek a balance between love and pressure.

Meeting all kinds of "comrades-in-arms" in the new class: the top student with a firm goal, the optimist who hides nervousness behind laughter, the fellow traveler also carrying scars... Who will become your support? Who will be your potential rival?

This year is an internal battle: under the desk lamp late at night, you struggle with function problems and English words, and fight against the constant onslaught of self-doubt.

The report card of each mock exam may become a spark that ignites hope or the last straw that crushes confidence.

Wavering between the obsession of "doing it again" and the fear of "what if I fail again", you search for the true meaning of perseverance.

short_description: What's the point of going to a lousy university? The principal is telling you to repeat the year. Lay a solid foundation in the third year of high school, and get into a 985 university in the fourth. This is a story-driven visual novel centered on the life of a senior year returnee.
